newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portugal Telecom jumps to new record.
newsitem.headline: Portugal Telecom jumps to new record.

text.p: Shares in Portugal Telecom jumped nearly two percent shortly after the opening on Tuesday to set a record high of 4,300 escudos, dealers said.
Early volume was a lively 64,000 shares.
With the strength of the dollar giving it a boost, traders said the stock could target 4,400 escudos on Tuesday.
The share was also being given a psychological lift by the success of the Telecel flotation yesterday which was heavily oversubscribed.
"As Telecel was placed at a pretty high price, investors believe Telecom is worth more," said one trader.

Traders said that some of the buying in Telecom could be coming from investors who sold stock earlier to make way for Telecel and then had not picked up all they had wanted in the mobile phone operator.
